evidence.localHandling: Login identity is submitted to ACP authentication; session material is stored only in OS-protected SecureStore. Passwords are transient and not persisted.
Current self identity, Company, Branch, and permissions are held in authenticated application state.
Only employee-authorized assignment projections, customer display name, bounded service address, and Job/Appointment evidence are rendered; no broad customer record is stored.
Own Workday state and timecard evidence are fetched from ACP; punch intent is sent without a client-authoritative timestamp.

Permission-gated own pay-statement status/artifact may be fetched from ACP and displayed in an isolated, non-caching WebView. No payment instrument, bank, tax-entry, or payroll-administration data is collected by Mobile.
API requests may carry safe request correlation and build/environment compatibility metadata. No third-party crash or analytics provider is integrated.
The app requests no device location. Directions pass an already-authorized service address to a user-initiated system Maps handoff.
No Contacts permission or API is used.
No camera, photo-library, or microphone permission/API is enabled in this candidate.
No advertising identifier or app-level device identifier collection was identified.
No usage analytics SDK or event stream is integrated.

submissionGate: Owner/legal must map this technical evidence to Apple's then-current definitions, third-party practices, retention, linkage, and final privacy-policy text before publishing answers.
